name: fused_pack_qkv
description: fused_pack_qkv(q, k, v, indices) -> (q_out, k_out, v_out). q, k, and v must share shape [B, S, H, D], dtype, and device; indices is a one-dimensional int32/int64 tensor. With N = indices.numel(), the result is q.reshape(B*S, H, D)[indices], k.reshape(B*S, H, D)[indices], and v.reshape(B*S, H, D)[indices], each with shape [N, H, D]. Negative indices wrap modulo B*S. The native implementation returns three new tensors that are views of a single (3, N, H, D) allocation; q, k, and v are not mutated. Input q/k/v strides are honored, and the op raises ValueError/TypeError for mismatched shapes, dtypes, devices, or invalid indices. The exercised dtype is bfloat16.
